title: Auxiliary memory/operator proof audit and reflected root moments
objective: Prove or identify the first precise failure in the load-bearing auxiliary model moment and reflected arithmetic replacement, without assuming the unvalidated source operator estimates or weakening the Goldbach objective.
deliverables: Actual edge/memory norm and moment proof or precise failing step
success_criteria: Source H2' or a desired norm is not silently assumed
A mathematical gain has a complete argument and separate review
All list/projection/root and limit costs remain explicit
The full Goldbach goal is not replaced by an auxiliary lemma
stop_conditions: One bounded theorem round within20 proxy units
No provider billing or external mutable action
A first load-bearing failure is recorded rather than hidden behind conditional notation
